description: This file contains the implementation of the ImmutableAddressMetric class, which is an immutable data structure representing address metrics with functionality to convert to and from JSON, as well as comparison and sorting logic.

classes.name: ImmutableAddressMetric
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the AddressMetric interface, capable of serializing to/from JSON, and providing measurement comparison and sorting functionalities.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableAddressMetric instance from a set of measurements.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an ImmutableAddressMetric object by parsing a JSON object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the metric measurements into a JSON object according to a schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getMeasurements
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of the measurements contained in this metric.
